title: axy's Artifacts
description: Turn "collectible items" into interesting and unique artifacts!
body:
## axy's Artifacts
![The axy's Artifacts logo with the new Globe Banner Pattern and Sentry Armor  Trim item textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9685b241f4caf912b8e2cfb6d2a9e1743033c22f.png)

##  Smiths & Patterns
### So what does this pack do?
This texture pack takes "uncraftable, collectible items", such as smithing templates and certain banner patterns, and retextures them with artifact-themed redesigns!

###  Additional details
- This pack is expected to work as intended for versions beyond 1.20.x
- This pack may or may not be subject to errors on **versions below 1.20.x** 
- **Mods are not required to use this pack**
- Submit a support request on my [⚙️Discord server](https://discord.gg/HZbvM2KBnR) if you encounter any issues

###  Social links
- Want to support me? Send a tip over on my [☕Ko-fi page](ko-fi.com/axyeatsrocks)! :D
- Join my [⚙️Discord server](https://discord.gg/HZbvM2KBnR) if you wish to get updates on my texture packs!

### Like what you see?
Check out my other packs if you're feeling generous!
- [🍯 axy's Honey Note-ify](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axys-honey-note-ify) - Adds a sticky note to beehives to indicate if they are full of honey!
- [🌱 axy's Sapling Seeds](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axys-sapling-seeds) - Turns saplings into tree seeds (stylistically)
- [💎 axy's Traditional Armor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axys-traditional-armor) - Reimagines the Programmer Art armor textures with a fresh coat of paint!
